pulses.name: Q1 2026 Malware Statistics Report for Linux SSH Servers
pulses.description: Analysis of attacks against Linux SSH servers during Q1 2026 reveals P2PInfect worm as the dominant threat, representing 70.3% of all attack sources. DDoS botnets including Mirai, XMRig, Prometei, and CoinMiner were identified as primary threats.
